race.comment: RUBYREGIS (5) resumes as the top selection despite two plain race starts, with the case built around a new campaign, a recent Rosehill trial and the 1.5kg claim for Jacob Stiff. Her Pakenham Synthetic run before the break was poor at big odds, but this is a more suitable point to reset in a modest Mdn and she gets the nod on upside. BON BATAN (6) has been costly to trust as an 11-start maiden, yet he had genuine cover-ground excuses at Port Macquarie, drops from 59kg to 56.5kg and has placed on good tracks. In the mix. CHECKOUT CHICK (7) draws barrier 1, gets a 2kg claim and brings enough 1300m placing form to make her a live danger. REINE DE CRISTAL (10) eases back from provincial company after two Kembla Grange runs and can improve enough to be a place hope in this easier assignment.
